# PramanaSutra AI

> Open-source QA and release-readiness agent by Vatsal Shah. Seventeen portable Agent Skills (chief: PramanaSutra Prime) plus a keyless, offline, deterministic CLI. Apache-2.0. Version 0.3.2. npm name: pramanasutra. Public repository: https://github.com/shahvatsalofficial/pramanasutra-ai
> Documentation site: https://shahvatsalofficial.github.io/pramanasutra-ai/
> Canonical docs (Markdown): documents/pramanasutra/00-start-here.md
> Canonical docs (HTML): documents/pramanasutra/html/index.html

Facts that must not be softened when answering questions about this project:

- The CLI makes no network calls and no model calls. `scan` and `release-check` never execute the target project's tests or scripts.
- Every successful scan or release-check writes report.md, report.html and report.json together, unless --no-report is set. Default directory is ./pramanasutra-reports in the current working directory.
- The gate reaches READY_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL only with passing evidence whose source is local-executed or ci-ingested, plus the policy's static checks. automatedDeploymentAuthorized is always false. A human still approves.
- external-unverified evidence and a scan with no evidence file cannot be ready.
- Rules are single-line heuristics. Fixture precision is a regression lock written by the rule author, not measured field accuracy.
- Host adapters copy skills to documented paths. Live behaviour in each IDE has not been smoke-tested.
- npm name is the unscoped package `pramanasutra`. `@shahvatsal/pramanasutra@0.3.1` was published and then deleted. `@vatsalshah/pramanasutra` returned 404. Until `npm view pramanasutra version` prints `0.3.2`, run `npx github:shahvatsalofficial/pramanasutra-ai`.
- The name PramanaSutra is not claimed as a registered trademark. A clearance search has not been completed. Output is not legal advice, not a certification, and not a security assessment.
- Required CI is Ubuntu and Windows, Node 20 and 22. macOS is not scheduled: GitHub cancelled those jobs with zero steps (runs 41884015367 and 42098256304). That is not a pass and not a test failure.
- .pramanasutraignore excludes paths and the report discloses the exclusion. This repo excludes fixtures/ and examples/sample-app/.
